_comment: The credential vault. The file has two members and nothing readable: wrapped_key — the random data key sealed under the master passphrase `nhub setup` asks for — and sealed, one AES-256-GCM ciphertext holding every record whole, names and kinds included. The working key lives as state in /var/lib/neutrino/vault.key. Managed from the Credentials page and by `nhub vault`; never edited by hand.
